Block 7 is that footnote; it runs the full measure across both columns, is set smaller (cap 17 px vs body 20) in serif italic, and I gave it role 'marginal_note' because the allowed role list has no footnote value and it is an asterisk-keyed aside rather than body prose. Block 4 breaks across the column gutter: it starts at the foot of the left column (the element carrying n 4) and continues at the foot of the right column below the Fig. 2.14 caption; that continuation is listed as a separate paragraph with n null rather than repeating n 4, since it is the same block in a second region. Fig. 2.13 (block 5) prints on bare paper, so no fill; its dot-cloud edges are faint, so its bbox is the extent of visible ink above a low threshold. Fig. 2.14 (block 6) sits on a yellow panel, fill #fffbd5 sampled from the flat interior well away from the pink lobes. Neither figure caption is covered by an A2 block, so both carry n null. A grey 'NCERT / not to be republished' watermark crosses the page; it is a print artefact and is not listed as an element.
